title.de: Dieser und jener: this, that, these, those
title.sl: Kazalni zaimki: this, that, these, those
title.it: Questo e quello: this, that, these, those

goal.sl: Pokažeš, kaj je blizu (this, these) in kaj dlje stran (that, those), vprašaš What's this? in odgovoriš z it in they, rečeš this one in po telefonu Hello, this is …
goal.de: Du zeigst, was nah ist (this, these) und was weiter weg (that, those), fragst What's this? und antwortest mit it und they, sagst this one und am Telefon Hello, this is …
goal.it: Indichi che cosa è vicino (this, these) e che cosa è lontano (that, those), chiedi What's this? e rispondi con it e they, dici this one e al telefono Hello, this is …
goal.en: You can point at what is near (this, these) and further away (that, those), ask What's this? and answer with it and they, say this one, and on the phone Hello, this is …

say.sl: **this** (ta, to) je za eno stvar blizu tebe, tukaj: **this cup** (ta skodelica v moji roki). **that** (tisti) je za eno stvar dlje stran, tam: **that fell** (tisti hrib tam). Spol ju nikoli ne spremeni: **this man** (ta moški), **this woman** (ta ženska), **that bike** (tisto kolo).
say.de: **this** (dieser, diese, dieses) steht für ein Ding in deiner Nähe, hier: **this cup** (diese Tasse in meiner Hand). **that** (der, die, das dort) steht für ein Ding weiter weg, dort: **that fell** (der Berg dort). Das Geschlecht ändert sie nie: **this man** (dieser Mann), **this woman** (diese Frau), **that bike** (das Fahrrad dort).
say.it: **this** (questo, questa) è per una cosa vicina a te, qui: **this cup** (questa tazza che ho in mano). **that** (quello, quella) è per una cosa più lontana, lì: **that fell** (quel monte laggiù). Non cambiano mai per maschile o femminile: **this man** (quest'uomo), **this woman** (questa donna), **that bike** (quella bici).
say.en: **this** is for one thing near you, here: **this cup** (in my hand). **that** is for one thing further away, there: **that fell** (over there). They never change for a man or a woman: **this man**, **this woman**, **that bike**.

examples.de: Der Berg dort ist Cat Bells.

say.sl: Za več stvari **this** postane **these**, **that** pa **those**: **these scones** (ti sconi tukaj na krožniku), **those boats** (tisti čolni tam na jezeru). Samostalnik je v množini in glagol tudi: **These scones are lovely.** (Ti sconi so odlični.) **Those boats are from Keswick.** (Tisti čolni so iz Keswicka.)
say.de: Für mehrere wird **this** zu **these** und **that** zu **those**: **these scones** (diese Scones hier auf dem Teller), **those boats** (die Boote dort auf dem See). Das Nomen steht im Plural und das Verb auch: **These scones are lovely.** (Diese Scones sind köstlich.) **Those boats are from Keswick.** (Die Boote dort sind aus Keswick.)
say.it: Per più cose **this** diventa **these** e **that** diventa **those**: **these scones** (questi scones qui sul piatto), **those boats** (quelle barche laggiù sul lago). Il nome va al plurale, e anche il verbo: **These scones are lovely.** (Questi scones sono buonissimi.) **Those boats are from Keswick.** (Quelle barche sono di Keswick.)
say.en: For more than one, **this** becomes **these** and **that** becomes **those**: **these scones** (here on the plate), **those boats** (over there on the lake). The noun takes its plural, and so does the verb: **These scones are lovely.** **Those boats are from Keswick.**

say.sl: Brez samostalnika pokažejo nekaj: **What's this?** (Kaj je to?) **This is Jack.** (To je Jack.) **That's** je kratko za **that is**: **That's lovely!** (Lepo!) V odgovoru prevzameta **it** in **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Kaj je to? — Pisalo.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Kaj je tisto? — Čebele.)
say.de: Ohne Nomen zeigen sie auf etwas: **What's this?** (Was ist das?) **This is Jack.** (Das ist Jack.) **That's** ist kurz für **that is**: **That's lovely!** (Wie schön!) In der Antwort übernehmen **it** und **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Was ist das? — Ein Stift.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Was ist das dort? — Bienen.)
say.it: Senza nome indicano qualcosa: **What's this?** (Che cos'è questo?) **This is Jack.** (Questo è Jack.) **That's** è breve per **that is**: **That's lovely!** (Che bello!) Nella risposta subentrano **it** e **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Che cos'è? — È una penna.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Che cosa sono quelle? — Sono api.)
say.en: Alone, without a noun, they point at something: **What's this?** **This is Jack.** **That's** is short for **that is**: **That's lovely!** In the answer, **it** and **they** take over: **What's this? — It's a pen.** **What are those? — They're bees.**

examples.it: Che cosa sono quelle? — Sono api.

say.sl: Da ne ponoviš samostalnika, reci **this one** (ta) ali **that one** (tisti): **Which cup is hot? — This one.** (Katera skodelica je vroča? — Ta.) **This one is hot, and that one is cold.** (Ta je vroča, tista pa mrzla.) Za več stvari samo **these** in **those**: **These are lovely.** (Ti so odlični.)
say.de: Damit du das Nomen nicht wiederholst, sag **this one** (diese hier) oder **that one** (die dort): **Which cup is hot? — This one.** (Welche Tasse ist heiß? — Diese.) **This one is hot, and that one is cold.** (Diese ist heiß und die dort kalt.) Für mehrere **these** und **those** allein: **These are lovely.** (Die sind köstlich.)
say.it: Per non ripetere il nome, di' **this one** (questo) o **that one** (quello): **Which cup is hot? — This one.** (Quale tazza è calda? — Questa.) **This one is hot, and that one is cold.** (Questa è calda e quella è fredda.) Per più cose solo **these** e **those**: **These are lovely.** (Questi sono buonissimi.)
say.en: To leave out a noun said already, say **this one** or **that one**: **Which cup is hot? — This one.** **This one is hot, and that one is cold.** For more than one, **these** and **those** alone: **These are lovely.**

examples.en: Which cup is hot? — This one.
This one is hot, and that one is cold.

say.sl: Po telefonu poveš, kdo si, s **this is**: **Hello, this is Sam.** (Halo, Sam tukaj.), nikoli *here is Sam*. Za **this is** ni kratke oblike, za **that's** pa je. Pri času je **this** zdaj ali današnji: **this morning** (danes zjutraj), **this evening** (danes zvečer), **this week** (ta teden); **that** je drugič: **that day** (tisti dan).
say.de: Am Telefon sagst du mit **this is**, wer du bist: **Hello, this is Sam.** (Hallo, hier ist Sam.), nie *here is Sam*. **this is** hat keine Kurzform, **that's** schon. Bei der Zeit ist **this** jetzt oder heute: **this morning** (heute Morgen), **this evening** (heute Abend), **this week** (diese Woche); **that** ist ein anderes Mal: **that day** (an dem Tag).
say.it: Al telefono dici chi sei con **this is**: **Hello, this is Sam.** (Pronto, sono Sam.), mai *here is Sam*. **this is** non ha la forma breve, **that's** sì. Per il tempo **this** è adesso o di oggi: **this morning** (stamattina), **this evening** (stasera), **this week** (questa settimana); **that** è un'altra volta: **that day** (quel giorno).
say.en: On the phone, say who you are with **this is**: **Hello, this is Sam.** (never *here is Sam*). **this is** has no short form, but **that's** has. For time, **this** is now or today's: **this morning**, **this evening**, **this week**; **that** is another time: **that day**.

examples.en: Hello, Mrs Birkett, this is Sam.
examples.de: Hallo, Mrs Birkett, hier ist Sam.
Heute Morgen ist es sehr kalt.

exercises.title: Mrs Birkett
exercises.text: Come in, {learner}! ___ is the Packhorse Inn. ___ table here by the fire is for you, and ___ scones here on the plate are fresh. Look out of the window: ___ fell over there is Cat Bells, and ___ boats on the lake are from Keswick.

translation.sl: Pridi naprej, {learner}! To je gostilna Packhorse. Ta miza tukaj ob ognju je zate, in ti sconi tukaj na krožniku so sveži. Poglej skozi okno: tisti hrib tam je Cat Bells, tisti čolni na jezeru pa so iz Keswicka.
translation.de: Komm herein, {learner}! Das ist das Packhorse Inn. Dieser Tisch hier am Feuer ist für dich, und diese Scones hier auf dem Teller sind frisch. Schau aus dem Fenster: Der Berg dort ist Cat Bells, und die Boote auf dem See sind aus Keswick.
translation.it: Entra, {learner}! Questo è il Packhorse Inn. Questo tavolo qui vicino al fuoco è per te, e questi scones qui sul piatto sono freschi. Guarda dalla finestra: quel monte laggiù è Cat Bells, e quelle barche sul lago sono di Keswick.
translation.en: Come in, {learner}! This is the Packhorse Inn. This table here by the fire is for you, and these scones here on the plate are fresh. Look out of the window: that fell over there is Cat Bells, and those boats on the lake are from Keswick.
